title: Nightruth: Explanation of the Paranormal #01: Yami no Tobira
native_title: ナイトゥルース ＃０１「闇の扉」
overview:
From the moment you open the door of darkness, mystery and terror will assail you...

The curtain rises on this story with the shocking incident of a girl who dies engulfed in flames. It was the entrance to the strange world that was about to unfold...

Set contents:
- Game software CD-ROM
- Collection of original art and setting materials
- Music CD

Nightruth #01: Yami no Tobira is an anime-style mystery and suspense adventure, the first episode of the Nightruth: Explanation of the Paranormal series. A girl's horrifying death sets off a chain of unexplainable events inside a school, and the story draws on well-known paranormal subjects such as spontaneous combustion.

You follow a cast of students as they look into the incidents, working through animated story scenes with full voice acting to uncover the truth behind them.

- One-player adventure for ages 18 and over
- Opening and ending theme songs

闇の扉を開けたその時から謎と恐怖があなたを襲う…。

少女が炎に包まれて絶命するというショッキングな事件でこの物語の幕は上がる。それはこれから起こる不思議な世界の入口だった…。
